  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as sales_lines,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as total_sales_net

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as sales_net,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0), 2) as returns_net,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) * 100.0 / SUM(fsl.net_amount), 2) as return_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
  AND ds.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format;

calls.statement:
WITH sales_period2 AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.format,
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
    AND ds.store_id < 900
    AND ds.format IN ('Large', 'Medium', 'Small')
),
returns_for_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    sp.format,
    sp.sales_line_id,
    sp.net_amount,
    COALESCE(frl.refund_net, 0) as refund_net
  FROM sales_period2 sp
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON frl.sales_line_id = sp.sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  format,
  ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) as sales_net,
  ROUND(SUM(refund_net), 2) as returns_net,
  ROUND(SUM(refund_net) * 100.0 / SUM(net_amount), 2) as return_share_pct
FROM returns_for_sales
GROUP BY format
ORDER BY format;
